title: eBird Checklist Failure Rate
dataSources: BirdNET detections (`birdnet:detection`), trail-cam detections (`trailcam:detection`), moth-trap captures (`mothtrap:capture`), bat-detector passes (`batdetector:pass`), pollinator counts (`pollinator:count`), wildlife-cam visits (`wildlifecam:visit`).
app: Backyard wildlife monitoring — BirdNET acoustic bird ID, trail cameras with object detection, camera moth traps, ultrasonic bat detectors, and pollinator counts — via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ebird:checklist
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(checklist_status,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by location_name
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often eBird checklist records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each location.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize checklist_status values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per location.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.
grandmaExplanation: It treats which parts of your eBird checklist data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
